title: Matzav Promotes Extremist Views
body: Matzav is criticized for amplifying extreme views from Satmar on Israel and the draft crisis, which don't represent the broader Torah community.

title: Rav Landau Gives Draft Bill OK
body: Degel HaTorah's leadership gets green light from Roshei Yeshiva Rav Dov Landau and Rav Moshe Hillel Hirsch to advance the IDF draft bill.

title: Ponovezh Yeshiva Ruling Issued
body: Retired Judge David Cheshin issues long-awaited ruling on Ponovezh Yeshiva, ending decades of tension and division. The decision will dramatically reshape the future of the Bnei Brak yeshiva.
